edges: Zoza seeks to wake the prince.
The Moorish slave steals the pitcher and claims the prince.
Zoza and the Prince live happily ever after.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Pentamerone is structured around the story of Zoza, a cursed princess.
The old woman cursed Zoza to marry only the prince of Round-Field.
The Moorish slave demands her husband tell her stories.
